title.zh: 能量与深度：结深不是能量单独决定
title.en: Energy and depth: energy alone does not determine junction depth

subtitle.zh: 投影射程 / 展宽 / 表面膜层 / 多能量注入
subtitle.en: Projected range / straggle / surface films / multi-energy implantation

body.zh: 01 确定目标深度
body.en: 01 Set the target depth

body.zh: 02；选择离子与能量；B⁺ / P⁺；As⁺；低能量；高能量
body.en: 02 Choose ion species and energy B⁺ / P⁺ As⁺ Low energy High energy

body.zh: 03 穿过表面膜层；表面膜层；硅（Si）
body.en: 03 Traverse the surface film Surface film Silicon (Si)

body.zh: 04 碰撞失能
body.en: 04 Lose energy through collisions

body.zh: 05 形成射程与展宽
body.en: 05 Form range and straggle

body.zh: 06 退火形成最终结
body.en: 06 Anneal to form the final junction

body.zh: 离子注入与深度分布；表面膜层；硅（Si）；离子在材料中发生多次碰撞并逐渐失能
body.en: Ion implantation and depth distribution Surface film Silicon (Si) Ions undergo multiple collisions and progressively lose energy in the material

body.zh: 不同能量的浓度-深度分布；浓度；低能量；中能量；高能量；退火后；深度；投影射程；展宽
body.en: Concentration-depth distributions at different energies Concentration Low energy Medium energy High energy After anneal Depth Projected range Straggle

body.zh: 注入能量；决定离子初始动能，；影响平均射程与展宽
body.en: Implant energy Determines initial ion kinetic energy and affects mean range and straggle

body.zh: 离子种类与质量；质量和化学性质影响；碰撞过程与射程
body.en: Ion species and mass Mass and chemistry influence collisions and range

body.zh: 表面膜层厚度；离子在膜层中先损失能量，；影响进入硅后的射程与分布
body.en: Surface-film thickness Ions first lose energy in the film, changing range and distribution after entering silicon

body.zh: 单能量或多能量组合；通过多能量注入调控分布；形状，获得目标结深与轮廓
body.en: Single-energy or multi-energy combination Use multiple implant energies to tune distribution shape for the target junction depth and profile

body.zh: 结深 ≠ 能量单独决定；结深由注入能量、离子种类、靶材、表面膜层和碰撞展宽等共同决定，；是多种因素耦合的结果。
body.en: Junction depth ≠ energy alone Junction depth depends jointly on implant energy, ion species, target material, surface films and collision straggle; it is the result of coupled factors.

body.zh: 工艺耦合与权衡；提高能量：平均射程加深 ↔ 展宽与损伤同时变化；平均射程加深；分布展宽增加；更易达到更深的结；晶格损伤加重
body.en: Process coupling and tradeoffs Increasing energy: deeper mean range ↔ simultaneous changes in straggle and damage Deeper mean range Greater distribution straggle Easier access to deeper junctions Greater lattice damage

body.zh: 可能的风险；结过深/过浅；影响器件性能；与可靠性
body.en: Possible risks Junction too deep / too shallow Affects device performance and reliability

body.zh: 分布深尾；增加漏电；与击穿风险
body.en: Deep distribution tail Increases leakage and breakdown risk

body.zh: 穿透阻挡层；破坏器件结构；与隔离效果
body.en: Penetrating the blocking layer Damages device structures and isolation effectiveness

body.zh: 模拟与实测偏离；需校准模型；优化工艺
body.en: Simulation-measurement deviation Calibrate the model and optimize the process

body.zh: 量测反馈：SIMS / 模拟校准/ 结深与电性；SIMS 测量；浓度；深度
body.en: Metrology feedback: SIMS / simulation calibration / junction depth and electrical SIMS measurement Concentration Depth

body.zh: 模拟校准；实测；模拟
body.en: Simulation calibration Measured Simulated

body.zh: 结深与电性；优化注入参数；获得目标结深；与良好电性
body.en: Junction depth and electrical Optimize implant parameters to obtain target junction depth and good electrical performance
